doc: Per-model facts of mono_layer monokernels (NOT part of the family schema). The UT request author (references/request-authoring.md, references/mono-layer-ut.md 'Requesting a mono_layer task') makes the profiled kernels matching a model's `kernel` pattern one mono_layer task per model and copies that model's entry, bind, attrs and const axes into the task's `scaffold`. `case_axes` expressions may use shape / context and {serving-arg} placeholders filled from the serving launch args (e.g. --speculative-num-draft-tokens). `world` is the deployment's tp. Values come from the model's config and the serving launch: check them. `oracles_ready` lists the contract oracle legs this model's worked example implements and a GPU run verified; `oracles_unverified` the legs it implements that no GPU run has verified yet (kept in the task's contract with their family bounds, provisional until the first GPU floor run calibrates them; the request says so); any other family oracle is dropped from the task's contract with a `scaffold.contract_overrides` entry and its why (the FILL agent is never left to write an oracle no example covers). `not_exposed`: outputs the model's runner never exposes, each with the reason (the request gives them `present_when: "False"` through contract_overrides). `entry_ops`: the profile's operator key(s) the model's launches resolve to (source_map op.key), for matching a graph-replayed per-width symbol whose stack did not resolve. `launch_waivers`: [{pattern, why}] builds of the model's kernels the worked example does not reach; the request carries them and scaffold_tasks.py expands them over expected_launches into meta.ut_contract.launch_waivers (the lint refuses one that waives nothing). `negative_controls`: [{leaf, category, find, replace, expect}] the model's mutations of its own kernel source, GPU-verified with its worked example; the request carries them and scaffold_tasks.py writes them into meta.ut_contract.negative_controls in place of the scaffold's FILL stubs (references/mono-layer-ut.md section 3 lists what a control must satisfy).

models.name: dsv41_flash_target
models.label: dsv41_mono_target_layer
models.widths_from: rows: decode tokens = requests x (1 + speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens) (DSpark 5: 6 a request); the launch names carry it as s<rows> (aiter::dsv41_mono_k1_s<rows>_tp<tp>_r<ratio>_tl<..>_f<fold>_i<index>, k2 the same without f). Served widths 6..48 (mono_decode.MAX_ROWS = 48, FULL graphs of 6, 12, 18, 24, 36, 42, 48); a step above 48 rows takes vLLM's path. launches = 5 UT layers a step, one of each served layer type: r0 fold 0 (served 1, Engram), r2 (3), r1 (21), r2 index source (8), r1 index source (24), each = K1 + K2 device launches (config compress_ratios, index_source_layer_ids, engram_layer_ids); pools = 2 (0: the layer's SWA fp8_ds_mla cache, written by K1; 1: the compressed cache, read only); kv_width = 512 (a record decoded: 448 e4m3 x UE8M0 + 64 bf16 rope dims); hc = config hc_mult; topk = num_experts_per_tok; world = tp (deployment TP2)
review: dsv41: the server calls MonoDecodeLayer.__call__ (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/mono_decode.py:650, runner.forward at :726) -> runner.forward (mono/runner.py:351) once a backbone layer; RankModel drives one layer a launch through DSV41MonoLayer.forward (references/examples/dsv41_flash_target_rank_model.py)

dsv41: the worked example's step is the 5 served layer types (r0 fold 0, r2, r1, r2 index, r1 index); an index layer's select copies a precomputed top-512 (vLLM's compressor + indexer stand-in). Not exercised: K1 r2 fold 0 index (served layer 14 only, waived by launch_waivers), the FFN launch (dsv41_mono_ffn_: no layer of this deployment takes it), the Engram write itself (vLLM's, before K1)
dsv41: the kernel pattern excludes the draft's builds (_e<experts>_k<topk>): model dsv41_flash_draft takes them
models.oracles_note: 2026-11-16 (no GPU): split = the deployed K1 + K2 call on the baseline overlay (DSV41MonoLayer has no per-stage mode; the Muse draft precedent): the candidate is judged against the baseline on every case at the family's bounds, and the baseline's floor is trivially met. native = vLLM's own non-mono chain (the op chain of vLLM's tests/models/test_dsv41_mono_numerics.py: MHCPreDelayedOp seams, the ROCm attention ops, the all-reduce over gloo, DeepseekV4MoE at TP 1 on the rank's shard), teacher-forced per launch, near-tie routing aligned on the FFN input K2 used. Bounds: the family's native SQNR floors, provisional until the first GPU floor run (/shared_nfs/hongtaom/dsv41_mono/gpu_validate_1116.sh) records the baseline's sqnr against native. 2026-11-13: deployed path GPU-verified (oracles then dropped).

not_exposed.ids: DSV41MonoLayer keeps the top-6 picks in scratch mailbox pairs (stages/moe.py 'route' region), whose layout is the kernel's own and may change under optimization; a routing bug is caught through stream_out / layer_out / stream_aux_out, which the routing_ids negative control has to prove

models.oracles_verified: 015 job 285905, 2026-11-17 (vllm image 6f126f27): every gate incl. the native oracle floor and 6 / 6 negative controls; baseline vs native min SQNR attn_out 31.9 dB, layer_out 49.0, stream_out 57.0, kv_rows 73.4 (floor 20); split bit-exact on 69 / 69; A/A full 0.99995, quick-timing 1.0007 (worked example references/examples/dsv41_flash_target_rank_model.py)

launch_waivers.why: K1 of served layer 14 alone (an Engram layer that is also an index source: fold 0 AND the index hand-out). Both branches run in the worked example's step on their own -- fold 0 at launch 0 (r0, Engram), the index hand-out at launches 3 / 4 (f1 i1) -- and the build key is the product of the two constexpr flags; K2 has no fold flag (its r2 i1 build runs at launch 3)

negative_controls.expect: K2's split attention scores scaled by half the softmax scale (qk_scale = HEAD_DIM^-0.5 log2 e): the attention output of every layer moves on every rank -> stream_out, layer_out, attn_out, stream_aux_out

negative_controls.find:
for src in range_constexpr(1, len(ws)):
                lo, hi = bf2_f32(ws[src][p])
negative_controls.replace:
for src in range_constexpr(1, len(ws) - 1):

negative_controls.expect: the FFN seam's TP sum of the attention output (wo_b partials pushed by every rank) drops the last rank's partial: at TP2 the attention contribution is rank 0's half on every rank -> stream_out, layer_out, attn_out, stream_aux_out on both ranks

K1 writes every token's fp8_ds_mla record one slot later in its SWA page (a wrong slot): the step's target records keep the 0x7F poison -> kv_rows non-finite, the neighbour records change -> kv_stray > 0; K2 reads the window through the right slots -> poisoned keys -> stream_out / layer_out / attn_out

negative_controls.find:
pos = ld_i32(a["pos"], 2 * t)
    slot = ld_i32(a["slot"], 2 * t)
    jr = tt - NOPE // 2
negative_controls.replace:
pos = ld_i32(a["pos"], 2 * t)
    slot = ld_i32(a["slot"], 2 * (t + 1 - 2 * (t % 2)))
    jr = tt - NOPE // 2
negative_controls.expect: the right slots in the wrong row order (token 2k's record into token 2k+1's slot and back; 6 rows a request, so pairs stay in a request): kv_stray stays 0, only the per-row kv_rows check sees the swap directly; the attention then reads swapped neighbours -> layer_out / stream_out move by less

negative_controls.replace: pass  # the record's scale word dropped
negative_controls.expect: a dropped store (the record's 8-B UE8M0 scale word): the step's scale bytes keep the 0x7F poison -> kv_decode marks the rows NaN (their zero pad byte is 0x7F) -> kv_rows; K2 dequantizes the step's own keys with scale 2^0 -> stream_out / layer_out / attn_out

the router picks its top-6 by score - bias instead of score + bias (e_score_correction_bias sign flipped): other experts for many tokens. The runner does not expose routing ids (the contract drops ids with an override), so the stream must catch it -> stream_out, layer_out, attn_out, stream_aux_out

models.name: dsv41_flash_draft
models.label: dsv41_mono_draft_layer
models.widths_from: rows: the DSpark draft block = requests x speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens (= config dspark_block_size 5); the launch names carry it as s<rows> (aiter::dsv41_mono_k1_s<rows>_tp<tp>_r0_tl<..>_f<fold>_i0_e128_k3_g1_w192, k2 the same without f): s5, s10, s20, s40 served (at most 8 requests). launches = 3: the draft's num_nextn_predict_layers (served layers 40, 41, 42: compress ratio 0, no indexer), the first fold 0 (the broadcast embedding), each = K1 + K2; pools = 1 (the layer's SWA fp8_ds_mla cache; no compressed cache); kv_width = 512; hc = config hc_mult; topk = dspark_num_experts_per_tok (3 of dspark_n_routed_experts 128); the runner's swa_width = get_dspark_swa_index_width(128, 5) = 192 (w192), ug_groups = mono_decode.DRAFT_UG_GROUPS (g1); world = tp (deployment TP2)
review: dsv41 draft: DSparkDeepseekV4Model.forward (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/dspark.py:188) runs its 3 DeepseekV4DecoderLayer's; each one's MonoDecodeLayer.__call__ (draft=True) calls the draft runner's DSV41MonoLayer.forward (mono_decode.py:726); RankModel drives one draft layer a launch (references/examples/dsv41_flash_draft_rank_model.py)

dsv41 draft: the block is non-causal (vLLM's DSpark SWA indices: the 128 context keys before the block plus the whole block, width 192); context records are random (served: precompute_and_store_context_kv)
